hero.title: Ecosystems Connected
hero.description: Engineering end-to-end IoT architectures, low-power sensor nodes, and real-time data streaming pipelines to bridge physical hardware with cloud intelligence.

capabilities.title: Edge Computing & Firmware
capabilities.description: Developing optimized C/C++ firmware for resource-constrained microcontrollers, leveraging RTOS environments and low-power sleep states.

capabilities.title: Mesh & Telemetry Protocols
capabilities.description: Implementing robust M2M communication pipelines using lightweight network protocols including MQTT, CoAP, HTTP REST, and ESP-NOW/LoRaWAN mesh networks.

capabilities.title: Cloud Integration & Analytics
capabilities.description: Architecting scalable backend infrastructure with time-series databases and real-time WebSockets for telemetry ingestion, data visualization, and remote device management.

projects.title: Predictive Maintenance & Real-Time Artillery Diagnostics
projects.description: This project modernizes conventional artillery maintenance by integrating embedded sensor networks, telemetry systems, and predictive diagnostics into legacy defense platforms.

projects.title: Machine Monitoring & Real-Time Operational Analytics
projects.description: This project implements a real-time industrial machine monitoring system designed for Industry 4.0 environments using ESP32 microcontrollers, current sensing hardware, and cloud-based IoT infrastructure.

projects.title: AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance
projects.description: This project is an AI-powered predictive maintenance platform designed to monitor rotating industrial machinery through real-time vibration and temperature analysis.
